name: Seeed Multi Channel Relay → Change Address
description: Stores a new I²C address, from `0x08` to `0x77`, in the board's memory. The board answers at the new address from then on, including after a power cycle, so run the action once and then set `address` to the new value.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: The board to change. Required with more than one board.
